title: Reply to a Slack DM
description: Practice responding professionally to a teammate's direct message.

hints: Make sure you're in the correct workspace — check the workspace switcher on the far left

steps.instruction: Go to 'Direct messages' and open an unread DM (or start a new one with yourself)
hints: Unread threads have a bold name with a blue dot
You can DM yourself by clicking your own name to test safely

overlay.text: Open the 'Direct messages' section on the left

steps.instruction: Type a clear, friendly reply and send it
hints: Be concise — professional tone doesn't mean stiff
If you need more time, say so: 'Let me check and get back to you by 3pm'
Shift+Enter for a line break, Enter to send
